rv.q: All four of these capable performers are ensemble players and keen listeners, expertly wearing their characters on their sleeves, and providing engagingly organic performances.
While Machine Learning is not nearly as fascinating as that unsettling little play, it does give me a clear sense of the stories that make Little Engine chug.
Machine Learning is a tight 90-minute drama with a stellar cast that explores companionship and the human condition (as all good sci-fi should).

cn.t: Critics find this AI romance exploration thought-provoking but uneven, with strong performances and an inviting production design elevating Kate Vozella's darkly comedic premise about couples training robotic companions.
